sql: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name LIKE '%g2%'

rows:
CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g2 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE taxn_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT,
    cat_lvl INTEGER,
    cat_nm TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(prc_usd) AS avg_usd_col, AVG(prc)/100.0 AS avg_prc_cents_to_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_null FROM items_g2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_both, AVG(prc_usd) AS avg_usd, AVG(prc)/100.0 AS avg_prc100, AVG(prc_usd*100.0/prc) AS avg_ratio, MIN(prc_usd) AS min_usd, MAX(prc_usd) AS max_usd, MIN(prc) AS min_prc, MAX(prc) AS max_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_null, SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prc_null FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(prc) AS min_prc, MAX(prc) AS max_prc, AVG(prc)/100.0 AS avg_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_with_price, ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 2) AS avg_listed_price_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL
